build.beforeBuildCommand: node scripts/copy-vendor.js && node scripts/generate-previews.js && astro build
build.beforeDevCommand: node scripts/copy-vendor.js && node scripts/generate-previews.js && astro dev

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: https://asset.localhost data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost
